name: FITC / mCherry double-positive
notes: "Some brightness in both channels" -- the operator's own first example. Both clauses carry a background-sigma threshold to show how a level is recorded when the operator does know one; leave the threshold out to let the evaluator choose.
_note: EXAMPLE. The signature rule is AUTHORED metadata only -- nothing evaluates it against an image yet (v7.9 decision D3). The 3-sigma-over-background level mirrors the floor already used by SpheroidDetector._threshold; it is a starting guess, not a measured value.
